events.explanation: Freed space on a nearly full disk by clearing regenerable package caches, unused container images, idle temporary folders and fully pushed idle worktrees, then installed a daily cleanup job.
The first cleanup pass was handed to the operator for review, and larger proposed removals needed the operator's approval before they could go ahead.
events.prerequisite: Operator review of the first pass and approval of proposed removals
events.reason: Larger removals were proposed rather than performed, as the original request asked
events.resumption: Work resumed when the operator responded

events.explanation: Fixed a cleanup defect that had removed a live session's temporary folder, identified two sources of refill, and removed approved stale worktrees after preserving their local-only work.
Recorded a handoff after the agent reached a usage limit, and the task continued in a new agent session.
Added continuous free-space monitoring that requests the existing cleanup under pressure, and traced repeated password prompts to a test's browser launcher so its owner could fix it.
During repeated critical shortages, cleared idle build caches and leftover synthetic test folders and made failed monitor alerts report honestly; free space still fell below the requested reserve.
After the operator changed the cleanup policy, retired compression and scheduled cleanup, kept a read-only monitor with agent-relayed alerts, and deleted expired inactive agent session data.
Built a reusable local disk-inspection app that needs the operator's administrator approval to run; its privileged measurements were not yet verified.
At the latest observation the task was still in progress with no recorded delivery or acceptance.

heading: Reclaim disk space on a development Mac and keep it from refilling
